location: Kecamatan Lubuk Sikaping, Sumatera Barat, Indonesia
summary: Single white light hovering near mountain, blinking completely off and erratically, moving horizontally, then vanished.
description:
I was at a location facing the Bukit Barisan mountain range in West Sumatra, Indonesia. It was nighttime, around 7:00 to 7:30 PM local time, with cloudy weather. The environment was very quiet; there was no wind noise and absolutely no sound of helicopters, airplanes, or any kind of motor.
Suddenly, a single point of white light appeared beside the mountain slope. It was not in the open sky, but rather positioned below the clouds, hovering beside the steep, forested slope. It was far above the ground and tree level, suspended in the air. The area has no roads or paths and is very difficult to access.
The light moved slowly and steadily in a straight horizontal line from South to North, following the contour of the mountain. It did not bob, drift, or change altitude.
The most unusual aspect was its blinking pattern. The light did not simply dim. Instead, it completely turned off and vanished into total darkness for a split second, then reappeared as a whole, single light again. This on-off blinking was rhythmically irregular, not like standard aviation strobes. When it was on, it appeared as one solid point of white light, not multiple separate lights.
After moving for a short…

summary: 3 giant white ping pong balls orbiting each other in a perfect equilateral triangle. Crossed the entire valley in seconds - no trails
description: Around 2pm on May 4th 2026 my girlfriend and I were sitting out on our front porch enjoying the afternoon sun when my girlfriend noticed a helicopter flying north over Lehi up I-15. Within minutes around the same spot between us and the mountain range appeared these 3 white spheres in a perfect equilateral triangle formation as if they had come from behind and up and over the mountain tops. She tried to point them out to me but I couldn't get a lock on them until they dropped down below the mountain tops so the contrast of the white on the brown mountains made them plain as day with the naked eye. Three giant ping pong balls slowly orbiting each other like a traingle spinning top (about the speed of windmills so they were probably orbiting each other at hundreds of mph but it looked slower due to the distance. The formation was also rotating on the triangle's Y axis simultaneously and with this crazy effortless look like it was falling sideways through the sky like an old screensaver. That's what it looked like! It looked surreal like primitive CGI not just the lighting but the movement like it was on this perfect mathematically calculated trajectory completely unaffected by the…

summary: A light moving at changing speeds not in a linear direction as a satellite
description:
I live outside of town and I have a habit of standing outside and watching the stars at night. I am familiar with seeing many satellites float across the sky or planes.
The object entered my frame of vision heading southeast in a sort of squiggle line fashion is the best way to explain it. It was almost like it wanted to look like a satellite but it couldn’t maintain a steady speed or course of direction. Speeding up and slowing down as it almost looked like a drunk driver swerving across the sky for a lack of better terms.
The object entered past over my house and as I stepped out into the yard to follow it, it began to curve slightly to true south. After changing directions its speed began to stabilize, it flashed and then the light just went out. Not over the horizon or behind a cloud, it was in the middle of a cluster of stars moving, flashed briefly and then just vanished.

summary: Visible in sky the night prior. Was in same spot this evening. Began to move, then vanish.
description: Last night (24hr prior to its movement) I was looking to the horizon, and noticed a rather out of place bright white light, it was stationary so I thought it was a star in the north west and left it at that. This evening as I was walking my dog, I noticed this same light in the same spot. I began to feel nauseous, and had a humming in my ears. (Not ringing, much louder.) I looked up and noticed this “star” that had been there for at least 24hrs had begun to move incredibly slow. Changing from a bright white ball, to an orange ball as it moved west toward the horizon. (Others stopped and observed on a dirt road beneath the hill I was on.) I began to pray as I felt this was a very negative experience. I then watched it over a course of 20 – 25 minutes as it slowly became smaller and smaller over the horizon until it vanished into the black night sky. Trying to look at it was challenging as it made my vision feel as if I was wearing someone else’s prescription glasses. In the duration of this experience the light would seem to flicker larger, and then get smaller as it moved away. As I was praying, another white/green light about the size of a sedan whizzed passed me in the general…

summary: Dual-Light (Non-Strobing) Single Airborne Object/Craft
description:
Observers: 54 y.o. female & 60 y.o. male; married; well-educated, rational, grounded, skeptical but open-minded; sober, clear-headed, cognizant & fully-oriented to self, place, and time/date at the time of observation.
Event: At 10:16pm EST we observed, with the naked eye, a small red light passing overhead & assumed it to be an airplane at first (we see these daily). It was first noticed at approximately 70° angle of elevation toward the SSE. The red light did not have adjacent strobing lights of any color (at the time, 3 airplanes were visible in the sky on clearly different flight paths to the NNW, which is where we normally see airplanes, all with red, green or white continuously strobing lights) and remained constantly illuminated for the duration of our observation. The light was moving from the SSE toward NNW at a steady pace with no apparent speed, direction, or altitude variations. Just after passing directly overhead, a second red light appeared right next to the first red light. The two red lights were oriented on a NNE/SSW axis. The second light moved exactly as the first light had (no deviation, strobing, etc) and the dual-light object continued its NNW trajectory…

summary: Clear sky, light moved fast, larger than a satellite, lower altitude, moved erratically, seemed to be jumping from place to place.
description: Very clear night so I was star gazing in my front yard. The moon had not risen yet and my neighbors did not have their lights on. I noticed a very fast light coming out of the northwest heading southeast at an altitude lower than a satellite, but about the same speed, moving faster than aircraft, and no red or green lights just a steady yellowish color. I wondered if it was ISS but that had passed over earlier. Also, there seemed to be a “jumping” or jerky movement to it, not steady, and sometimes it paused for a second. I wondered if my eyes were doing something weird but my husband came out and I pointed the light out to him and he saw the strange movement as well. Also, just before it vanished, there were 2 quick flashes in front of it, almost like a strobe had gone off against a cloud but the skies were very clear. After the second flash it disappeared instantly. I waited to see if it had disappeared behind a cloud I couldn’t make out but it did not reappear, something I think would have happened if it had gone behind a cloud. The whole episode lasted maybe 1 minute.

summary: While taking my dog outside, I looked toward the Northern sky, nearly directly overhead (the zenith). I noticed a large, pale yellowish-white orb of light near the Big Dipper. At first glance, I…
description:

​Characteristics: Instantaneous Acceleration, Shrank in size, Reacted to Observer

summary: Green orbs darting around in the sky too fast for any aircraft following in trail
description: I was looking at the stars with my brother and we at the same time had said "what's that light in the sky" we talked about it and looked closer and had seen that it was darting extremely fast looked closer behind it and saw 4 more smaller ones following behind not in perfect unison kind of sloppy and had heard a whooshing noise as we where looking we had lost it for about 30 sec and found it across on the other side of the sky then saw another bigger one about the size of and airport fly over and than they all disappeared as if they knew we where looking. saw a bright flash as they where leaving.

summary: Unidentified object returns nightly at sunset and stays between 400 and 600 feet and drifts around the property before leaving.
description:
Every evening around sunset, I watch this thing fly in from the rear of my property. It hovers around 400 feet and drifts around to various positions around the property. Usually 2 to 3 hours later we watch retreat in the same direction it came from.
Every evening around sunset for over a year, this white light maneuvers onto our property from the north. It changes color periodically from white to amber and uses various altitudes always staying out of clear photo or video range. When you spotlight it, it appears to dim and retreat or adjust altitude. We have notified FAA and local law enforcement who have had no answers. We are retired law enforcement and legal professionals who would appreciate some answers. This is very concerning.

summary: Coming from the north to the S/SE. I was thinking of whatever was up there when it appeared having seen it before.
description: I was looking up to the north when I saw it flashing at me. Before I was able to start recording, it was coming towards me flashing white and then all of a sudden it flashed orange and it looked for five times bigger when it did so. When I was able to start recording it appeared to be mainly white and at one point iridescent pink, but it also appear to change shape as it was traveling, and almost appeared black at moments as it was rotating or moving towards me. When watching the video back and zooming in it appears to look like a donut. This was my second sighting of the day but didn’t record the first one. It was the third or fourth sighting of the year.

summary: Path was north to south. I thought it was changing direction. Went behind a branch and then lost it
description: Green Flashing Orb above Clouds. north to south path

summary: Explanation: Balloon - Possible
description:
Cylindrical rotating slowly. No wings. Extremely shiny metal that brightly reflected sun. Reflection appears like a light.
We were driving westbound Hwy 70 and I was staring out the window when I noticed something in the sky. Maybe 40-50 feet in the air South of Hwy 70 flying North. I thought it was a drone, but as it got closer, there were no wings. It was an odd shape – cylindrical. I started describing it to my husband and said “pull over”, but instead he exited at Cave Springs and turned car around and parked at The Edge parking lot. It was now much higher in sky and sparkling when the sun hit it just right. We watched for 2-3 minutes until it disappeared from our view.

summary: Explanation: Starlink - Certain
description:
A long string of white lights moving kinda slow across the sky
Looking up in the direction Jupiter I saw a bright white light that looked unfamiliar as I got up to move to the darkest section of the yard I see several more white lights in a perfect row directly behind it as they moved West not fast but moving,no flashing no moving out of the straight line behind the first one and all evenly placed, they where the size of Jupiter is the best way for me to explain the size, it was like another star in the sky then half a ay across the sky they went dark.

summary: Explanation: Balloon - Possible
description:
Large transparent reflective sphere moving slowly. Witnessed for 3 seconds then it disappeared.
I observed a spherical object high in the sky at a far distance. It appeared highly reflective, with one side looking slightly translucent and the rest metallic. The object moved very slowly and remained visible for approximately four seconds traveling East. Just before the object disappeared, the intensely reflective side appeared to shift from right to left across the surface, as if the reflective portion was moving or closing over the sphere. Immediately after this change, the object vanished.

summary: Appeared as 3 glowing cube-shaped sections side-by-side with no gaps, forming one long rectangle.
description: It was about 9AM, I was traveling on 265W near mile marker 9 and it was moving faster than a normal airliner, no blinking/navigation lights, perfectly rigid spacing. At one point it turned enough to reveal a different 90-degree angle/side of the object from which I was able to confirm its unusual shape and no wings or tail fin. On my left was a high hill covered in trees in back of craft as it turned towards it. It was above the high hill but not by much. It appeared as 3 glowing cube-shaped sections front to back with no gaps, forming one long rectangle. It moved forward with one cube in the front and the other 2 behind it. It was a sharp turn. I saw it again when I was returning from that area around 1PM-1:15PM within 10 miles of the 1st sighting traveling 265 E.

summary: White light crossing night sky followed by smaller white light
description: Taking dogs out to use the bathroom and my husband pointed out a white light going across the sky due north. We always look up at the sky when we go out at night because we often see satellites. This light from this object however was brighter, felt closer, and was not overhead like the satellites usually are. When I looked at the light my husband pointed out, I noticed a smaller light moving parallel but below the larger light. I told him about the second light which he did not see when he first looked. The objects crossed the sky and the smaller light moved from being underneath the larger light, to behind it.

summary: Thought it was a shooting star but never changed color and changed direction with a clear fire trail behind it.
description: I was recording the moon in time lapse on a tripod while outside with my wife and son which I started to record at 9:09PM. At 10:01PM I was facing west when I spotted a bright light appear out of no where in the sky and can see the tail behind. I was excited and immediately pointed at it so my wife and son can turn around and see the “shooting star” before it burned out. I stopped my time lapse recording and start to normally record the object. I was glad to start recording before the object turn green. From my prior experience with shooting start when they turn green they are about to completely burn out. But as the video shows the object never turned green and began to change direction. It eventually flew behind the mountain and didn’t appear again. When I searched the direction the object was possibly flying over found it was towards Dana Point.

summary: Looking mostly west from residence
description: Spinning in a random pattern and elongating. Seen with naked eye but move captured with binoculars and cell phone video. We have no idea what it is

summary: Explanation: Balloon - Possible
description:
A big black orb floating in the sky. Windy day, but object would appear to hover then continue movement in alternating directions
I was driving to pick up dinner and I saw something in the sky out of the corner of my eye. I glanced and noticed it happened to look abnormal and glanced again and noticed it was a sphere. I had seen a similar sphere about a month previous and was out on a run and did not have my phone with me. I u turned immediately into an empty parking lot and began to film it. I took a few videos. The object moved inconsistently, sometimes it seemed to hover, sometimes it would drift. I got a few videos so I had to get going to pick up the food but I could still see it when I left. I also saw two planes in the sky within a 20 minute period, and both were far different , and much further away. The object was on the underside of the cloud level, the planes were not. It was a windy day and the orb did not seem to follow wind patterns although at that altitude it could be different, the clouds in the background were moving consistent and it would sometimes move with them, sometimes stop, sometimes go a bit to the side etc.

summary: I believe I saw a triangle leave the atmosphere
description: Heard a regular airplane fly north west overhead probably headed for Dallas love field or DFW because they both are in that direction. At a south south east angle I saw a white triangle fly at what I believe to be an upward leaving the atmosphere. It was there and I was watching it and it flashed clear and white three times then it just disappeared but the conclusion I come to is that it exited the atmosphere.

summary: The triangle came overhead slowly with light on each tip the sped away.
description: The low, rhythmic thrum felt like it was vibrating in our marrow before we even saw it. We were hunkered down in a jagged clearing, the scent of damp pine and woodsmoke heavy in the air, when the canopy gave way to a nightmare. It drifted into view at a crawl—maybe twelve knots—a massive, matte-black delta that seemed to swallow the starlight. In the army, you learn to identify airframes by silhouette and engine note. This had neither. It was a silent, obsidian triangle, indifferent to the laws of physics and the quiet of the woods. Fear is a catalyst. My buddies and I didn't hold a council; we reacted with the conditioned reflex of men trained for contact. The metallic clack-clack of shotgun slides echoed through the clearing as we shouldered our weapons. We opened up, the thunder of five 12-gauge rounds shattering the forest’s stillness. The muzzle flashes momentarily lit up the craft’s underbelly—smooth, seamless, and utterly unaffected. The lead shot must have peppered the hull, but there was no spark, no dent, and no change in course. It just kept gliding, a ghost in the machine, leaving us standing in the sulfurous smoke of our own useless defiance.

summary: Strange location and appearance of a large square or rectangular shaped light.
description: Immediately caught my attention because it was large and it was not the moon which should have been at 28 degrees of latitude. Then, it completely disappeared after five minutes. I am 68 and I have never seen anything like this.

summary: It made zero noise. I saw the tip come over the house followed by two more lights.
description: I was outside smoking because I could not sleep. I saw the tip come over the house followed by two more lights and I realized it was in triangle shape. It moves slowly. I ran upstairs to grab my phone then I ran back downstairs and was able to capture a photo. I am not saying that it was 100% a UFO I just have never seen anything like this before.

summary: I was heading back to work from the 5star down the road and spotted it pulsing watched it until it was directly overtop of me
description: I could see initially the pulsing light flying at a distance then I noticed we were closing the gap towards each other initially I thought maybe I was seeing a telephone tower or something in the distance it felt weird so I began recording then once it got close enough the light didn’t split but I’d assume from it flying overtop of me. I could see what lights where underneath it there was one green one and a faint red one that my video didn’t capture it seems I got to see the silhouette of it and what I seen was a sharp almost double tear drop shape with boxed edges it was night but the lights emitting underneath the craft gave me the opportunity to see how smoothly the curves of the craft transitioned it could just be a helicopter but I heard nothing and saw zero form of propulsion or wings to sustain a powerless flight

summary: The craft has defined sides and edges in the first image, then a longer tube shape
description: Around 12am I noticed the object just hovering motionless in the sky from my balcony. I took a picture, zoomed in on it and saw a gray metallic sphere with defined edges and a white halo surrounding it. The object was in the exact same spot at 3am when I took the second picture and zoomed in on it and saw that the shape had changed to a pinkish tube shape with two lights behind it and a defined shape, like a cockpit in the center.

summary: Bright green orb fell straight to ground from clouds at a constant, fast speed (lasted for 1-3 seconds)
description: A fairly bright green orb (appearing almost like a meteor) fell straight to the ground from the clouds way off in the distance (about 3-10 miles away, possibly further) in a span of only 1-3 seconds. I was driving to Jackson, TN from Henderson, TN, and at one point I saw this object far away in a direction that was straight ahead and to the left of the direction of my car. The object did not have a trail, did not change color or brightness, did not emit any noticeable sound (I was driving in my car with audio playing, so that could have washed out the sound), did not change speed or direction and did not have any other objects around it. I did not see any beams of light pointing at it, so I ruled out the possibility of the object being from a spotlight/laser of some kind.

summary: Flashing red and green lights in sky, object not moving. Suddenly zipped off to the left at a high speed.
description: I was outside in my yard, facing south. I looked east and saw bright alternating red and green lights in the sky. I observed for a bit to see if it was moving, assuming at first it must be a plane, although it looked more like lights on a tower. But I couldn't recall seeing any towers in that spot. I took out my camera to record and it continued to flash it's lights from red to green and then suddenly flew off, approximately northeast, at a very high speed. Not a speed any plane I've seen could do. I know it may be a military aircraft or drone, but I'd love to know for sure.

summary: A diffused light followed by a line of little bright dots flew slowly above our heads.
description:
A long rectangle shadow with about 6 little lights following a diffused white light (probably for vision) were spotted the 1st of May 2026 at about 10:05 PM.
The object flew very slowly from a ground POV so the speed, distance and size can vary depending on other values. The movement was from NW to SE, very linear. No changes in speed nor in direction.

summary: A blurred orb in front of a line of light
description:
I was sitting on the balcony and I say something in the clear sky without any clouds in vision .
It was like an orb in front but the light from it wasn’t clear and behind it was a straight line of clear light.
I saw it moving slowly not like any aeroplane.

summary: Big black object came out of the clouds and stayed stationary
description:
Was walking down the road to get back home stopped because a rock had gotten into my shoe. I lit a cigarette and was standing near the corner of the street when I looked up and noticed what appeared to be the edge of something black coming out of the clouds, i stood there and watched it as it descended to below the cloud cover it was what I can only describe as a cube shape, jet black, and looked to have something metallic on the top of it. It was very windy , so I figured I'd watch it and see if it was some sort of balloon or something. It stayed completely stationary the whole time I watched it. Did not move except for rotating , very slowly.
I could be mistaken, but it appeared to be shining something down toward the ground, As the bottom of it kept showing these green flashes. It seemed as if every time it slowly rotated and showed a different side of itself. This green flash like a light, but almost see through would turn on on the bottom of it for about 10 seconds and Then shut off again. By this time , I was genuinely weirded out as to what it could possibly be. It appeared to start moving towards the west toward the hudson river. I ended up walking up toward the main road…

summary: Silver egg/circle UFO floated for minutes, then shot upward and seemed to camouflage into the sky.
description: I was driving on rt 295 and than I looked up towards the sky and saw a shape between a egg and a circle it was silver and it was floating there for about 3 minutes it might of been lingering longer but by the time I noticed it it was only there for a few minutes and I was trying to figure out what it was than it shot up and it seemed like it almost was than to be camouflage into the sky trying to hide.

description:
Looked like it was not moving
More floating in the sky .. for a while

summary: 2 fixed stars,instanly moved from a standstill position,while I was looking directly at them
description:
Was out looking at the big dipper ,while the dog was pissing..directly over my head were 2 stars almost identical to the dippers stars.. but not part of it,
Suddenly they both started to move in tandem across the sky..instant acceleration, perfectly spaced, curved slightly to the north until out of sight.

summary: 3 really bright lights flew over my house, with a low bass hum
description: 3 really bright lights flew over my house, with a low base hum as I stood out front, the hair of my arms stood up, and I thought it may of been a Hercules transport plane but it had no flashing lights like a normal aircraft, also 20 minutes later, another low hum and a Hercules aircraft came over with lights on but they were different to the ones I'd seen

summary: It was a series of sightings. The most recent was several clusters in the sky. They are too close to be "satellites."
description:
Around mid April 2026 is when I saw a lot of light activity outside the eastern window of my apartment at night. The white one was blinking and flashing a series of lights in a ring. Yes, one of them looks like a red electrical pole, the other one looks like a street light. People don’t want to ask questions about them, and they change the subject. If this were true, wouldn’t it be attached to a light pole? Isn’t there a document somewhere or map of all the electrical towers and light poles?
On the night of April 14th I went to bed earlier as I was doing at the time, because these sightings were keeping me up at night and messing with my sleep schedule. When I woke up at 4AM they were out there wanting to communicate with me. I decided to get some sewing done. I turned on my string lights that change colors. They seemed to be fascinated by the color green, so I left it on the green setting. I got some sewing done and got ready for work. They were still out there, even though it was dawn. I was curious, so I started walking towards the white light to see where it was attached. It seemed shy, and kept moving subtly behind a tree as I moved. I went to get in my car to drive to work.…

summary: A 8 shaped craft went upwards and dissapeared into the clouds changing color when altitude increased
description: A craft went upwards shaped like an 8 and split into two circles

summary: No noise. Triangular shaped and possibly black. and at least 200ft wide at around 10,000 feet.
description: At least 200 ft wide. It was black and had maybe 8 white bright lights. Triangle shaped. Then saw object slowly vanished. Its around 10,000 feet altitude traveling north.

summary: Object disappeared, reappeared, still and moving slowly white shifting colors
description: I was looking at the stars facing NW and turned to face the moon, looking SE. As soon as I turned around, a very bright “star”, vanished. I kept looking in that direction and it reappeared about 10 seconds later, was still, then dimmed and moved slowly. It would freeze again, get bright and steady, then disappear again, only to reappear in another spot. It went in several directions, with a combination of being very bright, dimming, moving around, freezing, vanishing and so on. After I watched it for a minute or two doing this, I grabbed my phone to record. I recorded at 2x zoom. I could see it pulsating light with the naked eye and that it was shifting in color, but looking back at the video and zooming in further, you can see the shifting in color more clearly. The second after I stopped the video, it vanished again and did not come back. I waited a few minutes for it to reappear and I did not see it- at least not it the genre area it had been. I went back out several times to check if it was back and did not see it again.

summary: Explanation: Drone - Possible
description:
Flashing light blinking on and off every second, moving west to east, then changed direction and went south.
I saw flashing white light out my kitchen window at approximately 2:40 am on April 29th, 2026. I thought it was a plane or helicopter at first, as I live just south of Logan airport, but it had no other lights I could see. It seemed to blink about once per second and I couldn't see any other lights on it like regular aircraft would have. It was about as bright as a helicopter’s spotlight, which is what I thought it was at first. It looked like it was traveling west to east, toward my house. The light would dim occasionally, possibly obscured by clouds. It almost looked like it wasn't traveling at a constant speed, occasionally looking like it had paused in midair, and it did not seem to be going in a perfectly straight line. I will say the intermittent flashing of the light and the late hour could have just made my mind perceive that it was traveling unnaturally, but I don't think that’s the case. As stated previously, it first traveled west toward my location until it was about halfway up the horizon, then it turned hard toward the south. At that point, I went out on my…

summary: It was an oblong object with red lights that moved vertically top to bottom and slowly descended downward.
description: I was sitting on my porch watching the night sky. I noticed how QUIET it seemed. I looked to my left which would be in the NW direction and noticed a strange vertical line of red lights. At first I didn't notice it wasn't moving and seemed suspended in the sky. As I watched it began a very slow descent downwards. After about a minute or two of watching, it descended behind trees and was no longer visible.

summary: Explanation: Drone - Possible
description:
Thin object with no visible wings or tail, it vanished after I tried to look at it through binoculars.
My friend "L" was driving me and my other friend "B" home, we dropped off "B" and then began driving west towards Main St, I decided to look out the (back passenger) window where I was sitting and that's when I noticed this small light-grey "line" in the sky, I did a double-take and told "L" to slow the car down so I could try get a better look at it, we slowed to about 35 km/hr and I saw that the object was moving west at roughly 40-50 km/hr?
I looked through my binoculars and got a glimpse of it before my view got obstructed by a tree and a house, once we passed those I looked again but couldn't see it anymore…
We reached Main St and there I looked up behind us because I knew had a clear view free of trees and buildings… But I couldn't see it anywhere!
We continued to driving down Main St and I continued to scan the sky in hopes of seeing a plane to confirm my suspicion, I even checked FlightRadar but found nothing in the area!
My friend "L" thought it could've been a drone that descended out of view, that is possible for sure.
The object looked like a flat "line", appeared…

summary: I saw a circular shape hovering near my home, with black interior, and what appeared to be flames outlining it.
description: I saw a circular shape in the air, just hovering in front of me to the east a bit, as I drove south on 22nd Street, as soon as I crossed Bougainvillea. It seemed to a solid disc, that had flames along the outer edge. Flames had a red to orange color. The flame shapes undulated as if were actually on fire. I trained to be a firefighter for 2 years, and would have been one, but an injury prevented me from pursuing that career. I know fire when I see it, but this object did not seem like it was being consumed by the flames. I stopped, rolled my windows down, turned off my earbud, and heard no sound coming from it. I have trouble hearing certain tones, but should have been able to hear some kind of machine sounds if it were a helicopter or something similar. I turned East on Poinsettia, and it was above and in front of me. As soon as I parked on my street, I got out and looked where I had last seen it, but saw nothing. It was in my sight, for about 30 seconds total. Weirdly, there was zero traffic around. Nothing at all. This area is normally busy, even at this time of night. 22nd street is a busy road, but there were no cars visible from Busch to Fowler.

summary: Extremely bright star, twinkling, stationary, with erratic sudden slight movements
description: Looked out window and noticed one star brighter than the rest. The star looked as if it was "twinkling", began emitting a slightly red and green light, around the white "star". The star was mainly stationary, remained in the same spot in the sky for approximately 1 hour and a half, with erratic sudden unpredictable movements. The star would quickly and suddenly appear to move in triangular motion, but was unpredictable when it would move. Checked throughout the night, kept an eye through the window, looked back suddenly and there was no star there at all.

summary: Explanation: Satellite - Possible
description:
Two moving lights in nearly the same direction.
I come from an aviation background and can differentiate between aircraft and other lights. I stepped out as I do every evening before bed to give the dog one last chance to relieve himself. It was clear and I often see satellites moving across the sky as points of light. About a month ago I noticed something very odd – two lights in tandem moving at the same speed and very close together. I was not able to video this – only grab a photo. A zoom of the photo showed the points as lines with glowing orb centers, angled towards one another with each roughly 45 degrees off center.
Last night I saw a satellite and took a video to show the wife. As soon as I started capturing video, I noticed another point of light ahead of the first. The single large light is the moon and the rapidly moving light is a reflection of the front walkway light off the camera lense.

summary: a blue light that was moving at high speed.
description:
I was still on my way home when I spotted this blue light moving at high speed, seemingly circling the area. After a few minutes, it began to move away on the horizon.

All wore dark clothes. I complimented the girl on her ability to ride without training wheels, noting that my grandson, now six, used to ride with training wheels. The 'grandfather' said that the girl was only three and could do that. I didn't reply, not wanting to get into a 'dueling grandfathers' conversation. The girl looked at me with an unwavering smile brightening her face. She then said that "We told her (the girl) that it was a star so that she…

summary: Fast moving unvarying bright white light.
description:
Noticed it when opening a window ran and got 10x Vertex binoculars and went out front. From the time I first saw it until I stopped was probably a little less than a minute with about half that time watching through the binoculars. Perfect sphere, no variation in appearance.
It was very bright white like landing lights on aircraft or at least as bright as Jupiter and approaching Venus in brightness. I followed it approximately 90 degrees of its arc. No variation of color or brightness throughout its arc unlike landing lights that would no longer be seen when going away from me. I’ve seen the space station and it was much dimmer and according to the internet its track wasn’t over me at that time.
I got the impression that it was at airliner altitude but no way to judge scale. It was traversing the sky about twice as fast as airliners do at high altitude. Size wise it was about half the size of Venus and almost as bright.
There are lots of commercial and military aircraft overhead (I'm adjacent to Camp Pendleton) and I pay attention to them. I’ve not seen anything like it before. No launches were made at Vandenberg and they leave a contrail anyway.

As soon as I sprinted towards the window, the object reacted like it was already watching it. It disappeared from view, zoomed around a little bit, and then just hung there watching me. It was flying above the houses in the neighborhood. I live in a second floor apartment and there are no trees blocking the view from the sky. As soon as it saw that I noticed the object, the airplane sound disappeared immediately. It’s almost like it was playing a recording to pretend to be a normal plane. It looked rather close, maybe a half mile away from me. It was…

summary: White orb traveled straight line. Suddenly turned at 45 degrees, fast travel, vanished.
description:
My son called me to the porch at night. He and his sister were looking at the moon with a 40x telescope. He said, “dad come look at this white orb.” I came out and looked up. The sky was lit up well by the moon and there was a slight slight fog. I saw the white orb/ball moving in a straight line, same speed, not very fast. It was around 45 miles away, estimated, off to my east. I looked through the 40x telescope and it appeared to be a round white object just moving straight and steady. It was not an aircraft. It had no tailings, no condensate trail, made no sound, had no flashing lights, just a white ball moving. We stood there and watched it for around 3 minutes. Suddenly, out of nowhere, it turned south at around 45 degrees from my point of view, traveled about 3” to the south (about a 4.5 mile line when adjusting for distance), in about half a second. The white light simply vanished after that. I tried to calculate the speed, and estimated around 20-30,000 mph when all things are considered. The pre turn speed would have been in 100’s of mph. I was speechless.
About 15 minutes later a military plane flew overhead at low altitude, heading from the direction the white orb was at.

summary: Abnormal lights, abnormal shape, flying low and slow
description: I was driving on Argonne Ave and noticed two bright lights in the sky and pointed them out to my passenger. Initially, it looked like a plane with two bright white lights on each wingtip with 2-3 blinking lights in the middle between them and it was flying towards us head on. As I turned left onto Sunnybrae Blvd, it suddenly shifted and started moving sideways. Then it turned and I could see it had a dark, triangular shaped silhouette. At this point, I realized it could not have been a plane because it was moving at such a slow speed that would be perceived from a plane that was thousands of feet away, but I could see it was clearly much closer than that. I thought it could have been a drone, so I lowered my music and rolled down the window to see if I could hear any drone-like buzzing, but it did sound like a plane that was passing overhead, but at that proximity, it should’ve been much louder than it was. We lost sight of it as I drove to 711 and I could no longer hear it after I got out of the car. It was heading Northeast the last we saw it.

summary: Orange orbs in sky
description:
I am a Deputy at Sheriff's Office in southwest Missouri. A partner of mine had been sending me videos of what appeared to be orangish orbs floating and dancing in the sky. I believed him, however I wanted to see for myself. On March 23, 2026, my partner and I went on the back roads to try to locate them again. We saw multiple orbs, the first one we had seen was at a tree line, by the end of it had risen significantly higher, also it would dance, later that night we saw multiple different orbs at different altitudes. This has been the wildest thing, I have ever seen and I feel like I'm becoming a nut. However my partner has captured these orbs on video multiple times, I have given him this link so he can write what his experience was. I also want to mention we saw multiple aircraft flying towards these things, however we could not tell if it was an airplane or a helicopter or drone.
I decided to try and find if this is a natural occurrence or something else, so I decided to google it. To my surprise there is another individual from Stockton, Missouri who observed these things, which is not far from me. Another police officer from Joplin Police Department observed this as well.…

summary: Flashlight white light then it started flashing red and white
description: I went outside at 8:34 pm to take a leak. I was in the middle of peeing when I looked up and saw a bright light the same color as a star but it was bigger than any of the other stars in the sky. I was looking towards the North East where it was coming in my direction. The light at first made me think of a satellite just moving through the clear night sky until it flashed off. What immediately caught my attention is how far it had moved and when it reappeared is that it took an instant course change to the West. The light stayed on for about 2 seconds and then would flash off for one second and the distance it moved through the sky was twice as much when the light was on. It did this twice before it decided to instantly take a 45° turn for the south. The light stayed on then flashed off again. This time when it came on again it was flashing that starlight white with a red. The light stayed on alternating between white and red at different rates until it just disappeared going in a southern direction into the sky. During this time I also saw a satellite fly over and the light of the satellite was tiny and dim. This was bigger than a star and bright.

summary: One large unlit dark plane, followed closely by 4 other smaller craft in a V-formation.
description:
Late in evening, my wife and I were standing outside, enjoying the last lights of sunset. It was overcast, but visibility was several miles. Our property sits on a hill and has a view of the coastal range in the distance. We heard a helicopter in the distance coming from the west. This is common here, as there is a military base heading north towards Seattle. We see many different types, some flying quite low. They're well known around these parts, but mostly fly in a north or south direction - rarely from the west.
We saw, what we presumed, were the lights on the helicopter - one red, one white. Neither were flashing. It appeared to us both, that in the cloudy distance, there was a dark shape above the helicopter, barely visible. The helicopter was heading directly toward us and we could hear the noise of the rotors clearly as it approached. That was the only noise we heard as it approached. It's pretty apparent if there's more than one craft flying.
It was flying at what seemed a normal altitude, meaning we would be able to see what kind of copter it was. When it got closer, it became clear what we were seeing was a very large "plane" followed closely by 4 other much smaller…

summary: Bright white light. Smaller red light on left and blue light on right. Flew over city and AFB. No sound detected.
description: Standing on my 2nd floor balcony facing wnw, looked to my left (sw) and saw an odd silent flying craft, at least lights that were so close as to suggest they were of a single craft, but I couldn't make out a physical body. It was moving to wnw then turned to wsw and raised a little in elevation traveling maybe a half mile (directly away from me). It then turned to the east, headed towards The Strip. It was going behind the building and I hurried down the stairs to see if I could spot it again. While out of my sight the craft had turned to the north, basically following The Strip then angled over to Nellis AFB and beyond until out of sight. The first part took about ten seconds. The second part from over The Strip and to Nellis AFB took a little less. Drones don't fly that fast or that far. To my knowledge, no drone or anything would be allowed access to air space over a military installation during a time of war. The direction it disappeared to was headed pretty much right at Area 51.

summary: Explanation: Balloon - Possible

I was sitting on my back patio having coffee with my dog, and I noticed something moving in our general direction from the distant sky (east), it was not making a sound and it looked like a round object. As it got closer, I could clearly see that it was a metallic sphere or orb, silver in color with a shiny surface from the sunlight that was reflecting off of it- very surreal. When I realized that it was something different I pulled out my phone and started trying to film it. You can hear in the video that I was frustrated because I could physically see it in the sky, but I couldn’t see it on the phone screen in the moment while it was recording video so I was getting frustrated that I might not be getting it on camera. So I tried three different times to catch it. It was moving from east to west at a decent, steady rate of speed. There was no sound. It’s like it was hovering effortlessly in a predetermined path through our atmosphere either through the clouds or directly above them. It flew directly over Champions Golf Course at Weeks Park -and the neighborhoods directly east and west of it in broad daylight. After it passed over my building, I ran downstairs and…

summary: Orbs viewed in every direction
description:
(Most, but not all, of the events described below were recorded on video.)
At around 1:00 a.m., a coworker and I went to a location just outside the city of Mount Vernon. I wanted to show him a spot where I had previously seen glowing reddish-orange orbs in the sky.
As we arrived, we immediately spotted one orb that appeared relatively low, partially hidden behind some trees. As we started talking about how we wished it would move higher, the orb rose above the tree line and continued upward until it reached what seemed like a fixed position. The wind was fairly strong, but the orb held its position surprisingly well, though we could still see slight movement.
We then began scanning different directions and identified seven more orbs spread out across the sky. Each one appeared to move independently, almost like they were “dancing” or “playing.” They would brighten significantly, then fade.
What made this sighting different from what I had seen a few days earlier was that these orbs were moving individually. Previously, I had observed a group of orbs that would appear and disappear, sometimes forming a triangle. I also witnessed two orbs merge into one, become extremely bright,…

summary: Glowing stationary orb at bottom of cloud layer for approx 15 minutes duration above West Maui
description:
At approximately 10:40 pm I was getting into bed at 3000 ft elevation on Mt. Haleakala, off of Lower Kimo Rd in Kula Maui. Our bedroom view includes the North and South Shores, Central Valley and West Maui Mountain on Maui, and the islands of Molokai, Lanai, Molokini and Kahoolawe.
A Kona Storm was nearby, however the weather had cleared donsiderably and it was not raining that night in town or where we were on Mt Haleakala. The view of the Valley was clear and visibility good other than for a thin layer of clouds over the Central Isthmus of Maui, and cloud cover on top of West Maui. The lights of Kahului and Kihei could be seen clearly under the overcast and was slightly lighting up the bottom of the cloud.
As I went to close the drapes, I saw a large brilliantly glowing golden light in the lower layer of the cloud over the isthmus in front of the Northerly slopes of West Maui Mountain (above the general area from the town of Wailuku up to the Waihee Ridge Trail and over to the Iao Valley).
There is mountain is behind that location, and the mountain is unlit and undeveloped, so it's normally pitch black when the clouds clear.
I would estimate the altitude of the object (based on…

It was hovering in place and I thought maybe it’s a helicopter for a second. I pulled to the left into a driveway an turned back around to the lake road an went right down it. When we turned right I noticed about 4 red lights that were in a diamond shape on it all blinking in different patterns. We were about to the curve on the road when we were looking up and I could see a physical body to the light. It looked black and kind of had a rectangular form to it. It looked like it had mechanical elements to it. It was hard to put an exact size on it, but given its relative height, which I would say was…

description:
3 orange ball shaped objects moving through the sky.
On March 22nd, At 8:41 pm eastern standard time, in nw Palm Bay FL, I observed 3 orange colored balls of light, couldn’t hear any sounds coming from the objects, they traveled north over an undeveloped area of Palm Bay, west of heritage park way area. Appeared to be moving at speeds equivalent of an airplane. These objects seemed much brighter then normal airplanes that i observe in the area.

The size maybe about the size of small car, and middle seemed to be more of a darker orange as the outside edges of the orb looked almost yellowish white like heat was coming off it or something the same effect you see when you are driving down a hot highway and see the heat coming off the road but around the orbs edges. summary: Strange lights
description: 3 lights appeared in the sky and were silverish blue in color. They moved slowly forward, downwards, and upwards and flickered, occasionally would disappear and then reappear a few seconds later. A couple of times, only 1 or 2 lights would turn off. The way they moved reminded me of a floating movement. They weren't in a perfectly straight line, a slightly curved line. summary: Unknown object I observed for about 30 minutes that changed shape, color, and direction multiple times
description: Initially thought I saw what looked like a white wing of an airplane falling from the sky that came to a complete stop (approximately 300 m)and started to slowly change shape and move horizontally to the west. My son, his friend and myself grabbed our bicycles and attempted to follow it. And doing so I lost track of the object. After about 10 minutes, I spotted what I believe to be the same object at 2:29pm (proximately 500 m high). It now looked almost translucent, and appeared to have tentacles like a jellyfish. At this time, I zoomed in as close as I could with my camera on my phone and began taking pictures. It began to change shape, almost similar to an a Rubik’s cube and the color became metallic and silver and gold. It continuously morphed into different shapes. It started to resemble a large deflated balloon then took more smooth shapes mostly headed west, but appeared to head back east at one point in time. All while sporadically changing longitude. After about 20 minutes. It started to rise straight up and appeared to have turned red. It continue to rise extremely high. Until out of sight. Seemed much higher than the planes.

description: It looked like sheets of metal that sort of swarmed or flocked. Much too high to be birds and too reflective. Upon removing sunglasses it disappeared, and putting them back on made it visible again. My girlfriend was in the car with me and also saw this.

summary: Explanation: Satellites - Possible
description:

I was sitting in the backyard looking at stars because it was incredibly clear out and I thought I saw 2 planes on the horizon which is pretty common but then they faded away into the night and very shortly after another appeared in the same general area but moving in the opposite direction. They looked like far off airplanes or even satellites (points of light like a star) but as I sat there I realized I was seeing 4–5 at time moving in different direction and fading in and out. Then I saw one stop and change direction. After about 10 minutes I asked my wife to come out to see if she saw them. She saw them and we watched as these light moved in all directions for awhile and then I asked my teenage daughter to come and take a look and she confirmed we were all seeing the same thing. Through binoculars I could see others that were to faint to the naked eye. I pulled up my Flightradar24 app and it didn’t show any aircraft in the area we were gazing. At one point there were maybe 8-10 points of light moving all about. My wife and I sat and watched them for a…

summary: We noticed a white light moving across the sky, lit up bright as the sun for about 3 seconds before it dimmed back down
description: I was out taking pictures of the moon through my telescope. A white light flew across the sky coming from the southwest. When it got directly over the top of us (me, my fiance, & our friend) my friend asked us if we thought it was illegal to shine a green laser light at stuff like that and it immediately lit up bright as the sun for about 3 seconds before it dimmed back down. It was like it heard us and was saying hello!! I felt the hair on my arms stand up and had an instant weird feeling in my stomach. We were all so shocked but also amazed. The light flash had been so bright it left the shape of it even after when I closed my eyes. My fiance has 4 years in the Marines and 10 years in the Army and our friend was also in the marines for 4 years and worked on airplanes. They knew this was not an airplane. It was completely silent and did not have aviation lights like planes do.

summary: A faint, gray colored boomerang-shaped object appeared in our line of vision. It was close enough to identify the object.
description: My boyfriend and I were stargazing around 9pm when we both saw a faint gray boomerang-shaped flying object above us. We didn’t see lights on the object like we had observed with the other aircraft in the sky. There wasn’t a sound either. It was just gliding. It lasted a few seconds and then it was gone.

summary: Steady light moving in a strange manner, it'd go forward then pause a second and back up before moving forward again & zigzagging too.
description: i took my dog outside to potty before bed. a bright amber dot of light, much like a star, caught my eye. it was steady glowing and moving so slowly. i stopped walking to watch it & noticed that it'd stopped moving a second and then it backed up as if it were in reverse! it was traveling east from north & after it reversed it went forward again then paused and sat still then went straight up, paused, straight down, paused, reversed then went forward again a few seconds and just literally turned off. no sound. spectacular sight!

summary: UAP or experimental aircraft ?
description:
Looking south at approximately 95 degrees Azimuth, I noticed a light that I thought was either a morning star or planet. As I am deciding which and what one , the light began moving . It flew almost directly over my house at a high rate of speed . The last image I have sent , I enhanced adding contrast . You can clearly see structure and detail of geometric design. As it proceeded, I could see an aerodynamic condensation cloud stream , so I assumed it was a jet engine exhaust, but why would it be lit up like a Christmas tree in the desert? There was no sound as it flew over . I believe I did see this same object in the distance the previous morning, but thought again , it was a star , but when I went in my house to grab a star chart , I came back and it was gone .
The object was lit up with lights ALL over it. There are round circular lights jutting out like wings , but aren’t wings.
I can’t say what this was , certainly could be experimental aircraft given the condensation (or what appears to be)

It almost looked like it flashed occasionally because sometimes it was there then it would disappear for a second & appear but generally it was unblinking. If you zoom in on the video it sometimes almost looks V shape. Don’t know what it was but it was interesting!
NUFORC Note:
There is a permanent surveillance balloon located just south of Deming, New Mexico.
This system is part of the Tethered Aerostat Radar System (TARS), managed by U.S. Customs and Border Protection (CBP). The balloon typically floats at an altitude of about 10,000 to 15,000 feet while tethered to a high-strength nylon cable. Its onboard radar can "see" aircraft and maritime vessels up to 200 miles away.

summary: Cane Corso alarmed by dark shadow in enclosed bush corridor. Bright flash. No exit route. Entity vanished.

summary: It was dark. Triangles made up of lights. There were two. Couldn't tell if they were attached or just side by side
description: I was about to go to bed It was between 1:00 and 2:00 a.m. I heard a loud noise that sounded like maybe it was military aircraft flying low but didn't think much of it just as the sound faded I looked out the window and saw what looked like two triangles made out of light bright pegs, that's what it looked like. It was so dark out all I could make out was the lights, one up into the left the other down a little into the right. I couldn't tell if they were attached. I moved my head around because I was looking through the window of an old house and sometimes the wavy glass can play tricks but I was definitely looking at something that appeared to be two triangles made of lights I didn't hear anything and it just slowly moved away. Oddly the next day I heard we had a meteor but I promise you what I saw was not a meteor.

summary: Intense Light and Pulsing Noise
description: Intense light changing from red to gold and orange accompanied by a pulsing / surging noise and feeling. Did not actually see a craft but caught a glimpse of what I would consider an ORB as we were standing inside our bedroom at home. The light was so intense it lit up the entire room at 10:30 at night and happened twice the first time was for about 10 second and the second time also about another 10 seconds. Ran outside immediately and saw absolutely nothing and saw no sign of anything that could have caused the light or the noise. The lights in the bathroom flickered for a short period the next morning and TV’s were distorted when first turned on until they were reset.

summary: Explanation: Drone - Possible
description:
Bright light disappearing and reappearing in the sky
10pm went outside lock the gate, see a bright light in the sky, checked flight radar dismissed as aircraft, wasn’t flashing and was way brighter than aircraft, moved left over the sky, disappeared and then was back right. Moving different directions, kept disappearing and re appearing in different location. Watched it for about 5 minutes before started filming.
Definitely wasn’t aircraft. Potentially a drone? View angle 45 degrees would have been very high. No sound. Commercial aircraft fly in the area potentially saw it as well.

summary: Black triangle. Darker than the night sky. 1 red light on a corner, a white light on each of the other 2 corners.
description: Driving eastbound on the M4. I saw lights that did not flash the same way planes do, and this was not moving. As the road turned and we got closer, I said to my mother in the passenger seat, that's a black triangle. This triangle was darker than the night sky, 1 red light and 2 white lights total. 1 light per point of the triangle. It was not moving.

summary: UFO/UAP over Lincoln City, Oregon
description:
In the mid afternoon of 15 March 2026, this investigator interviewed an employee of a casino in Lincoln City, Oregon of a strange object seen to the west by him and another employee.
At about 5 pm on that day, the witness I interviewed was driving through the casino parking lot when he came upon another employee known to him looking west up into the sky. Upon exiting his vehicle he asked “ What’s going on?” The other person said look at the object in the sky… they both were looking at a mysterious orb, oval shaped object moving in an erratic manner. It was cloudy that day, little wind.
Distance to the west of where the object was hovering at about 40 degrees off the horizon could not be established, nor the size of this grey dark silver object. The witness I interviewed was a former U.S. Army combat veteran I have known for 23 years. He confirmed to me that THIS WAS NOT A DRONE OR KNOWN AIRCRAFT. It’s erratic maneuvering after watching it for about 1 to 2 minutes confirmed to the witnesses that this object was not a private, commercial, or military aircraft as it BOLTED AT A HIGH RATE OF SPEED TO THE NORTH INTO THE CLOUDS!
At the rate of its acceleration, the initial witnessed…

summary: Huge black square hovering over highway, almost invisible
description: I was stopped at a traffic light at about 6:20 am and the sky was completely dark and cloudless. Some small stars were visible. When the light turned green, I was looking upward and noticed a square shape in the sky. As I started to accelerate to enter the highway, I noticed another small square parallel to the first. Then, I was able to take in the enormous size of a huge square object about 250-350 ft wide about 360 feet up in the sky. It appeared that the two smaller squares were designs or objects on the flat surface of the enormous square. There were no clouds but the entire object blended into the dark, early morning sky almost perfectly. There were no lights at all and it was completely silent. I very much felt like this object was camouflaged and watching the traffic below. Looking back now, I “forgot” about the sighting and went about my day as usual, without a single thought to what happened even though I now remember that I was extremely disturbed at the time. I did not “remember” the sighting until midafternoon the next day. There was no “missing time” but just seemed to completely forget the even for about 32 hours.

summary: Red-flashing on/off 1/2 second every 1 second. Vertical ascending and descending. Erratic flight then straight line towards me.
description: I was laying on my back in my bedroom at the Sitka Pioneer home. I saw a red flashing light that was stationary in the sky. It’s location was due west of my position and at 30 degrees azimuth. After 15 seconds, the light ascended beyond the view of my window. I walked to the window. I saw the light again, it was at 40 degrees azimuth and it descended to less than 30 degrees azimuth, approximately 10 seconds after I watched it ascend vertically. The light began to fly erratically left-to-right. It’s speed was similar to high flying jet aircraft. The light appeared to tumble or, change it’s attitude. It appeared to fly over some small and sparse clouds. The light travelled Eastward, towards Eastern Channel. Eastern Channel is located adjacent to and, South of Sitka, Alaska. I estimate the lights altitude to be over 10,000 feet above sea level. At 12:28 AM, I saw 2 red lights appear to the left and to the right of the initial single red light. All 3 lights travelled abreast of each other in a tight formation. There was a faint white bar of light between them. The formation spanned over 100 feet wide. There was no sound. The 2 red lights to the left and right of the center red light…

summary: Explanation: Balloon - Possible
description:
Saw sphere move across the sky at approximately 1000 ft alt. Traveling west.
Was lying in hammock with the wife. Clear blue sky like one cloud in the sky. I saw a sphere in the sky maybe 45 degrees up from my view. The sphere was just that, literally a circle with no wings, no numbers on it or anything. Moving just a little faster than an airline plane. Zero sound from the object it was just zipping right across the horizon. It came from east and was moving west.

summary: Silent illuminated craft seen disappearing behind building at low altitude, not seen re-emerging.
description: I saw what at first appeared to be a small plane heading for the building at 10 Hudson yards, but it disappeared around or behind the building, and was not seen again. It was rather more illuminated than a typical plane would have been and the body appeared to be either cross shaped or x-shaped, somewhat like hummingbird wings. It was flying at about 3/4 the height of the building, it seemed, but was not seen re-emerging from the other side. There was no sound (my window was open). It was not a plane or helicopter, not a quadcopter (based on no sound), and was much larger than any hobbyist drone. The body almost appeared to be transparent and illuminated, like lucite. Lights were white, green, red, possibly blue. They were on, not flashing. I saw it through the (small) bathroom window so did not have wide field of view to observe it. It suddenly appeared in view, I was startled due to its trajectory and low altitude, and then in 3-5 seconds it was gone.

summary: Triangular object in which the lights were blue and red but it moved at a strange speed and in turns out of the ordinary
description:
Irregular movement and faster than an airplane, but less than a satellite.
Shortly after I arrived at work, I went out to the courtyard to pick up the clothes from the clothesline and I could notice an uncomfortable silence in the environment and when I looked up I could see the triangular object in which the lights were blue and red but it moved at a strange speed and in turns out of the ordinary I could observe it for approximately 30 seconds to later disappear, from past events since childhood I have been able to observe objects out of the ordinary because I live in a place far from the Luminic contamination, which allows us to observe the sky clearly from previous sightings, the most important were 12 years ago with multiple triangular figures, almost perceptible in their form, which took routes to the hills near which I live.

summary: A spinning light in the sky, in one place for a time, before completely disappearing
description: A spinning light in the sky, in one place for a time. After several seconds, it disappeared. It was too low to be a plane or helicopter, and too high to be a paper lantern or balloon. It could not have been a shooting star because of the prolonged still motion. It stayed in the air and appeared to spin then completely disappeared.

summary: Taking a walk around the neighborhood and saw craft heading to North
description: I was out taking a walk on a clear day, no clouds, the moon can be seen in the sky. I got a strange feeling and saw a craft that appeared to be 5-7 cm in size (from my view) above me a bit to the north, think 15 degrees from straight up to the North. If you were to watch someone walking on the street at 5mph thats how it appeared in sky. No glare but was the whitest white I have seen. I watched it as it had a strange way of floating movement and then it went upwards possibly as it went to a size 3-4cm (my view). I watched it maybe for 8-11 seconds and then went to get my phone out to zoom in initially and take a picture. I saw it in my phone and I tried to zoom in (probably should just take a snapshot as is, my mistake) my initial objective was to zoom in with the phone to get a better view. As I was attempting to get a picture it was gone. There's no way at that current speed and altitude that it would of escaped my view to regain sight of the object. I guess hard to judge size buy I'd estimate it was initially at the standard elevation of a flying plane. It was gone and I continued my walk and then noticed a jet flying to the south pretty fast and then another going to the North…

summary: Silver short cigar shaped flying at incredibly high speed
description: I stepped out of my camper van to take my dog for a short walk before turning in. I'm visiting from California. I happened to look up and saw a bluish silver cigar shaped ufo flying from North to South at very high speed. It wasn't that far above me. It made no sound. The odd thing was, it was fuzzy or blurry as if it was out of focus. As I watched it for about 7 seconds, it suddenly disappeared. It just vanished. The night sky in North Phoenix AZ was crystal clear.

summary: Two objects moving NE silently and unblinking in sky
description:
I have been consistently having sightings almost every day since 14DEC2025 when something changed. This particular sighting has the best imagery. I was outside with my daughter before her bedtime to look at the skies. We observed Venus in the West but when looking straight up we observed a white bright dot moving in a NE direction. As it came closer and almost directly above us it appeared to have a second craft slightly infront of it which looked smaller.
I had my cell phone (apple iphone 16 pro max) and my camera (Sony a7ii with a Sigma 105mm F2.8 lens and a tripod). I set up the Sony camera and took a series of phots and video while we watched in awe. These objects appeared to have small flashes of light appear briefly around them on the full traverse across the sky until it dissip0eared from view to the far NE.

summary: Pulsing orb in the eastern sky with the sun behind it

Too high to be a helicopter; too still to be an aircraft on approach. Also, it was illuminated with the sun behind it, not shadowed. My son is ten, has been to Space Camp, and is one of those "young Sheldon" super genius kids. He has ZERO interest in the paranormal. I've been trying to get him to watch AGE OF DISCLOSURE for over a month; no interest. We high fived all the way to school where I promptly instructed him not to say anything to anyone. Not in 2026 America.

I observed two of the others going up and down, left and right, sometimes revolve around each other, and grow bright and then dim to the point I couldn’t see them. They repeated this multiple times. At times one of them would head north as if it was going towards the one that was stationary. As it travelled in that direction, it would dim to the point that I couldn’t see it. Then I would suddenly observe two of them back in the original spot just above the trees going up and down, left and…

summary: Two white lights, kept equal distance between each other and moved together in perfect synchronisation. No other visible lights.

The object I have seen was not visible itself, it was dark just like the night sky. There were only two white lights, perfectly distanced from each other, flickering in sequence, first it was left white light flicking off, then the right white light. The position of the lights however have not changed even when the object changed direction from South to West as mentioned. It was perfectly synchronised. The law states that aircrafts need strobe lights and navigation lights, this object was below clouds level, had no navigational lights nor strobe lights. Which is violation of the law as I read. The object continued to circle around the area and then just, vanished. The lights just were…

summary: Two high speed orbs at great distance, one higher than other. Parallel flight. Abrupt turn out of atmosphere.
description: I saw two objects in the east southeast sky traveling north at quite a high velocity. They initially looked like stars but were moving in parallel. They didn’t seem like jets because the brightness was up front as they were moving toward me. One was farther than the other (higher altitude it seemed). No flashing lights. Then they took a turn east and outward as if moving outside the earth’s atmosphere. Then the lights grew dimmer and dimmer. What kinds of objects do this. Are there any online posts about something like this. Note: I’m thirty nautical miles from the sea. Their angle in the sky was between 45 and 50 degrees. From 45 degrees went to about 50 degrees when Turing east and up from me (90 degree right turn, away from me). I have seen similar objects while viewing potential star link satellites and the space station crossing over south/southeastern sky last year during the summer. These did the same turn away from me and disappeared shortly after the space station passed. In this case, those orbs were brighter and were about at the level of the space station, but the almost 90 degree turn away from my pov was impressive and the the gradual reduction of their brightness…

location: El Cuco, San Miguel Department, El Salvador
summary: We have been staying here for the past 2 months. We see at least one or 2 of these objects almost every night w/ flashing lights.

We see them most every night and have seen similar in Upper Michigan. We have been down here in El Salvador for past 2 months. This is my 2nd time reporting. After my 1st report on these a line plane flew by one night and the lights on these objects went off and we did not see them again that night.

location: Touws River, Western Cape, South Africa
summary: Reappearing strange lights in sky at the same time every night for the last week.
description: The first sighting I saw was last week at 3:40 in the morning . The lights come in from all directions and up and down . They fade in and out and are about 5 to 10 km from where I am away. There are no runways or humans in the area. Just mountains after the first sighting they began to visit at 9:55 every night. They appear for 30 to 40 minutes and then stop. They move at the same speed as a really fast drone but come in from really high up and there are between 3 to 7 new ones coming in and going out per minute.

summary: Looking at western sky a giant dark object with 2 brighter white points on each end lit up the shadow of the craft/object

Again dark and silent 2 lights white in color lit up the shadow of the craft as it passed quickly in a second or two. Higher than that of a plane, lower than a star - perhaps a tad lower than a satellite (i watch them often). This was actually startling. Moving South to NorthNW

As I turned to go back to my apartment, I noticed a very large bright fire orange light in the sky above the gravel yard lot lights. I'm looking east through the trees at the gravel pit on the hill. From our parking lot you can clearly see the high power lot lights for the gravel yard. The orange object could be seen moving very slowly up and down left to right around the treeline. The intensity of the light varied from extreme to dim as it was moving in what seemed to be a search pattern. At times going below the treeline, but bright enough to see through the trees. I continued observation as I wasn't sure if this was possibly a fire in the woods. The orange…

summary: UFO Sighting in Honolulu, HI
description:
At 2:45AM on March 9th, 2026, my partner and I were on holiday in Hawaii. We were staying at the Royal Monarch hotel on the 33rd floor next to the Ala Wai Canal. Andrea was awake at this time when she observed a strange set of oscillating lights outside the east facing window. She watched for a minute then woke me up asking me what was outside the window. I looked over and observed some kind of craft, either rectangular or disc shaped, with the cover of night it was difficult to tell, that appeared to have 6 light panels of flashing lights, bright white on the far right turning a dull white until a red light on the far left. Our best guess is it was about 1/2 mile away, over the residential area of Honolulu, towards Kaimuki. We watched the event in awe for a couple of minutes. The craft hovered in place, then simply disappeared. Then, we believe we saw it reappear moments later off in the distance multiple miles away. The reappearance was denoted by the appearance of bright strobing lights of the same nature. It was present for about a minute then the lights disappeared again.
On Sunday 3/22, we woke up early and turned on a recent episode of Ancient Aliens we had not yet had a…

summary: Camera captured a bright flash; reflection on car hood shows a slowly rotating, unknown object or shape.
description:
At the time of the event, the camera recorded a sudden, intense burst of light that completely illuminated the driveway and the two cars parked there.
The flash itself lasts for a few seconds, but the most unusual detail occurs during this illumination. If you pay close attention to the hood of the white Toyota Corolla parked on the left side of the driveway, the light source reflecting on the vehicle does not appear to be a standard flash. Instead, the reflection shows what appears to be a distinct object or shape that is slowly rotating.

summary: Glowing likely human figure
description:
Glowing Green Figure in Glen Burnie, MD. March 8, 2026, at approximately (9:42 pm). Observed from a residential bedroom near the 7-Eleven Quarterfield Rd, Glen Burnie, MD.
I observed a mysterious figure descending from the sky. The object had a distinct human-like shape and was glowing with a steady green light that appeared to come from inside the figure itself. It did not flicker or change brightness.
Motion and Behavior:
The figure was falling very slowly and perfectly vertical. It did not move horizontally like a plane or streak quickly like a meteor. As it fell, it stayed the same size, which suggests it may have been further away than it first appeared. I watched it until it seemed to land or disappear behind the houses in my neighborhood.
The event was completely silent. (I was watching through a closed window). It looked like a person’s silhouette made of green light.
Comparison: It did not look like a typical drone, skydiver, or meteor due to the steady internal glow and the slow, vertical speed.

summary: Green fireball being chased by helicopters
description: Several low flying helicopters were flying by around the river area, causing my to look outside. At that moment, a green fireball shot across the sky, flying fairly low. It then went out of my view and two helicopters followed it.

It was also not a planet or a star due to the fact that I did not…

summary: BRIGHT saucer shape hovering in sky. Zero stars, towers, or cities for 30 miles. Military searching overhead the next day!
description:
Driving home from our son's basketball game on March 7, my family and I witnessed the BRIGHT white hovering saucer shaped silent craft hovering over our hill.
No stars that night. And, so rural there isn't a town, city, tower, or airport for 20 miles all around.
My son grabbed 2 pictures. One of the object "hovering" and 1 as the object flew off faster than you can blink.
Lived here 20 years, and have never seen a helicopter...or plane really...overhead. (Maybe 3 times in 20 years a plane.) The next morning, our entire family was woke by 4 Blackhawk and Chanook helicopters flying around our house/hill! We looked immediately at live flight radar. The military helicopters were searching an area in a grid search pattern...with our little town in the middle of the search area!!! NEVER had such a thing happen in our rural area like this.
