summary: After a mass shooting event I witnessed a UFO stalk a news helicopter
description:
Tragically there was yet another mass shooting event in Rhode Island which caused a news helicopter to circle or fly through the city of Providence.
A helicopter was just heading towards my apartment as I stepped outside. Fairly low. To get a better view of it I stepped onto my front porch steps. The helicopter made smooth and long right turn heading east, as I was watching it a bright light caught my attention.
It was a perfectly round, circular "orb" it was glowing but did not give off any light or halo. I believe this object was curious about this helicopter. I saw move at a fairly high speed in a very smooth and completely silent path directly towards a low medium sized cloud. I watched this cloud for what had to be 10 minutes before it drifted out of sight, anxiously awaiting for this Orb to move away from this cloud. It never did.
This was around 5:11 - 5-15 PM still fairly light out
From my perspective the cloud and Orb were only slightly higher than the altitude of the helicopters path. It was in my personal opinion following the helicopter, trying to be as sneaky as possible.
It's 2026. I know what drones are. I know what they look like, sound like, do, can not do. Why…

summary: Pilots observed bright luminous sphere with erratic movement over Bay of Biscay for 3 minutes.
description:
Ryanair flight FR1902 (Madrid-Dublin), February 16, 2026, 06:52 UTC. Two commercial pilots observed a single bright luminous sphere at approximately 46N, 8W over the Bay of Biscay.
The object appeared as a bright, self-luminous sphere with white/silver coloration. It exhibited unusual flight characteristics including:
- Erratic, non-linear movement patterns
- Rapid directional changes
- No visible propulsion system
- Silent operation
Observation lasted approximately 3 minutes before the object accelerated rapidly and disappeared. Weather conditions were clear with good visibility at FL380 (38,000 ft). Both pilots are experienced professionals.
This sighting occurred approximately 7 weeks after a similar sighting by TAP Air Portugal pilots over the North Atlantic (Dec 26, 2025). Technical report available upon request.

It flew at a steady speed (similar to a helicopter) and at angle of 70 degrees from my perspective. It might have been flying 200-300ft above the zoo. It flew towards the east and remained in a linear flight path. It was unnlinking, but seemed to morph and pulsate. The light would have been the size of quarter if I held out my arm at full extension. It appeared mostly whitish, but closer pictures and snapshots of my video I took on my phone of the object reveal a spiking shape and translucent white exterior with pinkish and blue hues. It remains round but slightly spikey, like a star. Eventually, it passed out of view in the distance. It never made an sound, no humming.

summary: I saw a bright orange colored donut in the sky in chicago
description:

It wasn’t moving like a plane or helicopter would—it just kind of stayed there in one spot. The color didn’t change or blink, and there was absolutely no sound, which made it feel even stranger. I couldn’t see any wings, flashing lights, or anything that made it look like a normal aircraft.
After a short time, it didn’t shoot off or fly away. It just slowly faded out until it was completely gone. There were two of us who saw it, including me, so I know I wasn’t imagining it. I’m generally pretty skeptical about stuff like this, which is why the whole experience stood out and has stuck with me.

summary: Perfectly vertical amber sliver hanging in the sky

While walking the dogs tonight with my wife, I stared into the sky in front us and tried to figure out what was hanging in the sky above the tree. There is a radio tower nearby and I initially thought we were seeing an antenna panel from it but I realized the tower was off to the right and plainly visible.
I saw a perfectly vertical, amber light or rod. The light was not brilliant, which explains why I thought it was a panel visible from reflected light from below. It stayed completely stationary and I watched it from that position for well over five minutes.
I've seen a variety of things in the skies in my life and was a trained aircraft spotter in the Navy. This defied all explanation. There were no recent rocket launches. No Starlink releases today/tonight. Not ISS. It was not ice crystals or a sundog as sunset was an hour prior and it was 46 F. Not a plane or a drone. It didn't even look like the UFOs I have seen. A perfectly vertical amber line in the sky.
The streak was roughly the length of my thumb width held at arm's length.

NUFORC Note:
There were numerous reports of a bright fireball (a very large meteor) over Utah, Wyoming, and Colorado on the evening of Thursday, February 5, 2026.
Thime aligns with reports submitted to the American Meteor Society (AMS), which logged dozens of sightings between 9:00 PM and 9:45 PM MST.

The blue-green color usually indicates the presence of magnesium or nickel in the meteor's composition as it vaporizes upon entry into Earth's atmosphere.

summary: Spinning Cigar UAP accompanied by Orbs
description:
I was outside during a perfectly clear daytime with deep blue skies when I noticed an unusual object in the sky. The surface appeared shiny and reflective, catching the sunlight distinctly.
The object was spinning or rotating a full 360 degrees clockwise as it moved. It rose steadily upward in a vertical (or near-vertical) trajectory, continuing to ascend smoothly and silently until it became too small or distant to see and completely disappeared from view. There was no visible sound, no exhaust trail, no wings, lights, or conventional propulsion features. The entire observation lasted about 10min.
Immediately after noticing it, I tried to film and photograph the object multiple times with my smartphone camera, including several longer recordings where I kept the phone pointed at the sky in the area where the object was visible to my naked eye. To my surprise, the cigar-shaped object did not appear at all on the camera—neither in the live viewfinder/preview nor in any of the recorded videos. It was completely absent/invisible on the…

summary: Two black horseshoe crab shaped objects heading the reverse direction of the Seatac arrivals flight path.
description:

At first I thought they were very large balloons of some sort, but they only moved horizontally as I saw them, and were never ascending like a balloon, or the way anything else without propulsion might ascend as it moved in the wind currents.
There is also not a lot of wind to credit their speed to, and the part that has me very confused is that they both kept angling upwards 90º, with their tip at the back of the object pointing downwards, briefly,…

summary: Very fast bright amber light moving north. Faded out a pulsed back many times before disappearing after holding a steady brightness.
description: Saw a single very bright amber light straight overhead traveling north moving very fast. I thought it was a shooting star at first but then realized it was not. It never burned out the way a shooting star does. It traveled north until out of sight over the foothills. Compared to a jet liner it was easily moving four times as fast. I'd say better than 2,000 miles an hour. Before it disappeared over the foothills, it faded out but then pulsed back to full brightness. It did this multiple times before finally going out of view behind the foothills. I've seen the ISS many times. This was moving far faster through the night sky. I just randomly stepped outside and there it was. Weather was clear and calm with a lot of extra light from a very bright moon. After seeing this I had goosebumps for a good fifteen minutes. Definitely not a satellite or ISS or any kind of plane or helicopter. I can't even begin to guess what it could have been.

I recorded them and observed for over 3 minutes before we redirected our landing. Our pilot said we changed course due to winds but I didn’t notice any change of winds or interference in feeling. A plane flew directly by the lights and it was evident I was not mistaken in my judgement of their abnormality.
I have been observing aerial phenomena for nearly 20 years and felt something in the sky before I saw it.

summary: I observed unidentified aerial objects over coastal waters with unusual movement while U.S. Navy aircraft were actively circling
description:
While looking out over the ocean, I observed two to three lights that seemed to be flashing and flitting about in a cluster, then disappearing, then showing up again. They were roughly at same aircraft altitude as planes coming in to LAX (5,000 ft?). Initially I assumed they were conventional aircraft in the distance, but one light suddenly moved a significant distance from left to right (east to west, parallel to the shore) in less than a second and stopped abruptly, with no visible trail or sound. I couldn’t believe what I was seeing but I saw exactly that. The movement was rapid and hummingbird-like. I immediately checked Flight Radar for flights in the area. FR showed that at the same time this happened, a U.S. Navy P-8 Poseidon aircraft was circling offshore in repeated patterns for over an hour. They were still up there, two hours after I saw the lights. Weather conditions were clear, some light cloudy haze, and the lights were visible only as points of light with no discernible structure.

summary: Seen on security camera on a nightly basis for weeks
description:
Started noticing them last year. Appeared on security camera on a nightly basis around 1:30am. Lasted for weeks. If they remained longer than that, I do not know. I searched a few times but never seen them other than on my cameras and porch. Chalked it down to drones...
About 2-3 weeks ago, my cameras are picking them up again. They appear on camera about the same time every night. Usually between 3:30 and 4:00am. Can be seen between up to when the sun starts coming up. Same flight patterns, same type of light, Dim and then bright flashing. Fast and semi erratic movements. Again, first thought drone of some type. Last night, I seen them on camera, and went out into the freezing cold to look for them. summary: Swarm of dozens of UAP, similar looking to satellites but changes in direction
description:
On 24 January 2026, 0047hrs ACDT, I stepped outside in Adelaide, noticed five point-like lights in the sky (looked like satellites) close together, moving with the same trajectory, but then deviating. I pointed my compass, 3016 mils (south), altitude 286 metres and saw Three heading east, two southwest. All silent.
Over the next hour, at least 40 more appeared, I had lost count, drifting predominately in an E, or ENE direction. Ninety percent steady blue, ten percent white. Three of the whites flared bright as the ISS, held for five seconds each, then dimmed. One, after its flare, slid south, then did a clean S-turn, then proceeded east and vanished.
A half-second white blip flashed in that same slice of sky right after. No red or green strobes. No engine noise. No moon. Sky was black, no clouds.
I started recording—only caught my watch and the compass. Footage's useless for detail, but the time and bearing are on screen. I filmed sober, military, no visual problems. Some might've been Starlink and legitimate satellites, etc but 50%+ weren't following any train or normal satelite trajectory.

As it continued, the light grew brighter, almost as if it turned toward me. Suddenly, there was a large flash, followed by what I can only describe as a smoke ring. The object then rapidly accelerated south.

Then additional lights started appearing in a sort of line, but they were each different shapes, colors, orientation in the sky, varying levels of brightness, and they all seemed to phase in brightness around the same time, but not exactly. I kept waiting for break in the clouds, but when they approached, the light would fade, I could never make out a craft, or light source. I also posted my video I captured on TikTok where someone commented that they also saw the event while driving “back from Michigan”. So I can’t verify where they were, what they saw, but they said they pulled over and have pictures of the event from that night. description:
I have lived in the mountains since I was little, true countryside. One night, I went out to close the corral because the dogs were agitated, barking at the hill. The sky was clear when I saw a large, bluish-white light appearing behind the mountain. It didn't blink, it made no noise at all.
The light simply stopped in the air. It stayed there for a few minutes, with other smaller lights swirling around it. The air became heavy, my phone turned off by itself, and the dogs hid. Then, it moved sideways without tilting and ascended at an impossible speed, disappearing into the sky.
The next day, the grass near the corral was flattened in a circle. I know what I saw. That was neither an airplane nor a star.

summary: Saw two very bright "stars", one above the other. But i know my night sky and noticed instantly these were out of place.
description:
I was running a Northern Lights tour at Þingvellir, something I’ve done for over a decade, so I’m very familiar with the night sky and with the kinds of phenomena you normally see out there.
When we arrived at our final location, sometime around 9:50–10:00 pm, we stepped out of the car and almost immediately noticed a very bright fireball shooting across the sky. I’ve seen fireballs many times during tours, but this one stood out. It left a trail as expected, but unlike most fireballs I’ve seen, it didn’t break up, burst, or visibly end. Instead, it traveled from south to north for roughly 6–8 seconds and continued all the way until it disappeared behind the horizon. It also stayed the same color the entire time, which felt unusual compared to the color changes I normally see as fireballs pass through the atmosphere.
Later on, while we were stargazing and I was about halfway through my program, I noticed two very bright, star-like objects to the north-northwest, roughly in the direction of Hvalfjörður. What immediately caught my attention was that those “stars” were not supposed to be there. They were clearly out of place.
At first, both objects remained completely stationary…

summary: It was very scary; my friend and I thought we were going to die.
description: I was finishing dinner and took a nap. I woke up at 11:00 PM, took a shower, and lay down on the sofa. It was white and kept changing color; first it was green, then yellow, then a very light blue, and it stayed those colors until then. My friend said that it was very strange. So we went inside, put on pants and a long shirt, grabbed two machetes, one for me and one for him, and we kind of started following it, but we were running because that thing in the sky was not normal; it was very fast. Then suddenly it started coming down. My friend and I stopped and went into the tall grass. When we looked, it was in front of us, very far away, like about 40 meters. While I was watching, I also noticed that much further up and to the right of the main area of activity, there was a fourth light that was much fainter, and twinkled in several different colors like a star. I believed it was a star until I noticed that it was very slowly and casually moving up, down, and right in it's own sort of small area. After coming back out with my phone, I observed all 4 lights for about another 10…

summary: Bright blue-white orb zipped low and silent NW–SE, far faster than jets or aircraft; not a meteor or reflection.
description:
Foggy Land, Clear Sky.
It's a clear night sky with the moon shining bright. Stars visible. I know what shooting stars look like (I see them almost every night on clear nights, especially summer nights) but this was way too low to be a shooting star, and moving way too fast to be a plane or helicopter. I was walking to my car, and I noticed a very bright light-blue/white light in the corner of my eye. I looked up just in time to see it zip away until I couldn't see it anymore. It wasn't light reflection from passing cars, because the road I was near runs directly east to west, and the orb was traveling northwest to southeast. Completely silent. I've seen the Blue Angels at airshows growing up, and I understand they're moving somewhere around 150mph when doing low passes over crowds, and this orb made those F-18's look like turtles. It was probably flying even lower than when those F-18's do crowd flyovers. Very bright, and very very very quick.

summary: Hypersonic blinking green light
description:
Time of Sighting: Approximately 00:10 local time (Kuwait)
Duration of Sighting: About 15 seconds (initial streak was brief, then observed longer while tracking it)
Witnesses: myself and my wife
My wife and I observed a fast-moving aerial object from our hotel room window, initially facing south. It first appeared as a bright horizontal streak across the sky, similar to a meteor entering the atmosphere. I immediately moved closer to the window to track it.
As I followed its path, the object noticeably slowed down. At this point, I observed a steady blinking green light, which appeared on what would be the correct (starboard) side for a conventional aircraft. However, there was no visible red port light, white strobe, or tail light that I could detect. After slowing, the object then accelerated rapidly again and made a sharp turn to the north before disappearing from view.
The speed was extraordinary—estimated at Mach 2 or possibly Mach 3 based on my experience. I am a qualified F-18 pilot and am very familiar with high-performance military and civilian aircraft appearances, speeds, and lighting at night. Conventional jets at those speeds would produce a visible sonic boom…

summary: Circular object, with flashing lights in blue and white. It seemed to be hovering in the air, and then it disappeared
description:
The Night I Saw a UFO
Last night, I was coming home after a night with friends when something completely unexpected happened. It was around 11:30 PM, and the sky was incredibly clear, with stars shining everywhere.
When I stopped at a corner to look up, I saw a strange light on the horizon. At first, I thought it was a plane, but soon I realized it wasn't. The light was moving quickly and silently, without the typical noise of engines.
It was a circular object, with flashing lights in blue and white. It seemed to be hovering in the air, and then it disappeared at an incredible speed. I stood there, frozen, trying to understand what I had seen.

summary: Shape with pinkish/purple nodes
description: Observed a solo craft moving at an extremely high speed from the North, transitioning East/Southeast. The object emitted a loud, rhythmic mechanical humming/vibration captured on my home security audio. It featured distinct pink/purple orbs, or nodes, on each side, which do not match standard FAA navigation lights. While the object was overhead, my dog became non-responsive and failed to recall despite repeated commands. The craft then performed a rapid, vertical nose-dive behind the tree line past Lafayette Street toward the Great Swamp area. No sound of impact was heard.

summary: Flash of light, black circle in center of light, then darted off and upwards
description:
I was driving down plant street from the 429. I believe I was facing west. The sky illuminated right above my eye line like a flash of lightening, but it stayed lit in the middle of the sky. Amongst the illumination was a pure black circle. Almost looked like it was just missing light there in a perfect hole. The instant I even realized what I was looking at it darted off at an upward angle leaving a blue white and green looking trail that vanished as soon as it appeared. I’ve lived in Florida my whole life and watch rockets launch all the time but I’ve never seen anything move that fast. It was almost inconceivable. The entire interaction last maybe a second and a half.
It almost looked fake. Like vfx in real time in the sky. There was zero trace of anything that had flown through the sky.

summary: Explanation:  Chinese Lantern - Probable
description:
Orbs moved silently from NW to SE at medium speed in train formation over a period of ten minutes.
I walked onto my pool deck just after midnight and saw two orange orbs moving toward the southeast. No sound, no navigation lights, traveling in a straight line. Slight pulsation in brightness. Called for wife to observe and grabbed my phone for video. Orbs would proceed SE and begin flickering before fading from view. The stream continued for approximately ten minutes, with all following the same behavior as the lead objects, decreasing brightness and fading from view. I consulted Heavens Above website for satellite passes, and of course it was too late at night for any. Checked my Flight Radar 24 app for local radar contacts and found none. They all moved at a speed I would characterize as general aviation speed (I am a pilot), possibly 80-100 knots. No altitude estimate, but they weren't that high, I think. Maybe a couple thousand feet? I captured good video of most of them. The last one observed followed a different, more easterly track before disappearing.
